mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 declined for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased production boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% for 3 consecutive months) signals a stable economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stable prices support consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL was below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as both demand and labor market conditions improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy is expected to slow.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST declined by more than 10% for three consecutive months.
